title: LAB49 Senior Android Engineer
description:
Lab49 is a global consultancy focused on delivering innovative technology solutions for the financial services industry. We work with leading investment banks, asset managers, and financial institutions to solve complex business and technology challenges.



The Role



We are looking for an experienced Android Engineer to develop and deliver production\-grade native Android applications and features. You will work closely with other engineers, architects, product managers, and designers to build high\-quality mobile solutions and contribute to the overall engineering lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities



* Design, develop, and maintain native Android applications and features.
* Build production\-quality solutions using modern Android development practices.
* Integrate REST APIs, platform services, analytics, and third\-party services.
* Write unit and UI tests to ensure application quality and reliability.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical, performance, and production issues.
* Contribute to CI/CD, release readiness, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver features within agreed timelines.
Required Skills \& Experience



* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong Android development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDK.
* Hands\-on experience with Jetpack Compose.
* Good understanding of MVVM/MVI architecture.
* Experience with Coroutines, REST APIs, JSON, and mobile networking.
* Experience with JUnit, Espresso, and automated testing.
* Understanding of mobile analytics and accessibility.
* Strong knowledge of Git and modern software development practices.
* Experience building and supporting production Android applications.
What You’ll Bring



* Strong hands\-on Android engineering skills.
* Focus on code quality, testing, and maintainability.
* Ability to solve complex technical problems independently.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Experience working in enterprise or complex technology environments.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: LAB49 Principal/Lead Android Engineer
description:
Lab49 is a global consultancy focused on delivering innovative technology solutions for the financial services industry. We work with leading investment banks, asset managers, and financial institutions to solve complex business and technology challenges.



The Role



We are looking for a hands\-on Android Principal Engineer to provide technical leadership for Android engineering across key workstreams. You will be responsible for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards, and delivery, while remaining deeply involved in implementation and code reviews.



This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, leadership, and the ability to influence engineering decisions across teams.



Key Responsibilities



* Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of complex Android applications.
* Define Android engineering standards, development practices, and architectural patterns.
* Drive technical delivery across Android workstreams and ensure high\-quality production outcomes.
* Conduct detailed code reviews and provide technical guidance to engineers.
* Mentor and enable Android engineers across the team.
* Partner with architects, product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver scalable solutions.
* Drive application performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to CI/CD, release engineering, and engineering automation.
* Identify and resolve complex technical and architectural challenges.
Required Skills \& Experience



* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in Android development.
* Strong expertise in Kotlin, Android SDK, and Jetpack Compose.
* Deep understanding of MVVM/MVI and modern Android architecture.
* Strong experience with Coroutines, REST APIs, and JSON.
* Experience designing scalable and maintainable mobile applications.
* Strong understanding of mobile application security and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD and modern software engineering practices.
* Strong code review, technical leadership, and mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional engineering teams.
What You’ll Bring



* Strong hands\-on engineering mindset with architectural depth.
* Ability to lead through technical influence rather than hierarchy.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Experience working in complex, enterprise\-scale technology environments.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Flutter Developer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Flutter Developer** with 3–4 years of hands\-on experience in building, developing, and maintaining **cross\-platform mobile applications** using Flutter and Dart. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of mobile application architecture, API integration, state management, and performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain **cross\-platform mobile applications** using Flutter and Dart.
* Build scalable, reusable, and high\-performance application components.
* Convert **UI/UX designs from Figma/XD** into responsive and pixel\-perfect mobile interfaces.
* Integrate **REST APIs, third\-party APIs, payment gateways, and external services**.
* Implement state management using **Provider, BLoC, Riverpod, GetX, or similar frameworks**.
* Work with **Firebase services** such as Authentication, Cloud Firestore, FCM, Analytics, and Crashlytics.
* Implement secure authentication, push notifications, deep linking, and other mobile functionalities.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize applications for performance and stability.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-documented code.
* Perform testing, bug fixing, and application maintenance across Android and iOS.
* Collaborate with **UI/UX Designers, Backend Developers, QA, and Project Managers**.
* Manage code using **Git/GitHub** and follow proper development workflows.
* Participate in application deployment and release processes for the **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.

Required Skills

* **3–4 years of professional experience in Flutter development**.
* Strong proficiency in **Dart and Flutter**.
* Hands\-on experience with **REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and third\-party integrations**.
* Strong understanding of **Flutter widgets, layouts, navigation, animations, and responsive UI**.
* Experience with at least one state management solution such as **BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, or GetX**.
* Good understanding of **mobile application architecture and design patterns**.
* Experience with **Firebase and push notifications**.
* Knowledge of **Git/GitHub, debugging, testing, and performance optimization**.
* Experience developing and deploying applications for **Android and iOS**.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
